row.evidence: Zoho Directory documents SCIM Directory Stores for Okta, Entra ID and JumpCloud, and Zoho People help says users synced into Zoho Directory "automatically appear in Zoho People", but no Zoho People page names the plan that includes it.
row.notes: New row. Scored as a provisioning target: an IdP can push users over SCIM into Zoho Directory, the shared identity layer, and People help says synced users appear in People and disabled or deleted Directory users lose access. People's pricing comparison has no SSO/SAML/SCIM line and People's Zoho Directory help names no plan, so the gate is undisclosed; Zoho Directory's Free plan is capped at 10 users. www.zoho.com/people/pricing.html returns a 404; the plan comparison page is used. The forms-based People API (employee insertRecord, record fetch) starts on Essential HR; Free has no API, and higher call limits are a paid add-on.

scim.notes: SCIM lands in Zoho Directory (the org-wide identity layer every Zoho app uses) through a Directory Store; the "Sync endpoint" URL is generated per store and its pattern is not documented. Zoho's Okta guide pairs the SCIM app with a SAML app pointing at Zoho Directory Custom Authentication, but the Entra, JumpCloud and custom-store guides do not require SSO, so sso_required is left null. Zoho People's Zoho Directory help covers SSO, security policies and AD/LDAP sync; it does not mention SCIM or name a People plan.

auth.token_source: Zoho Directory Admin Panel > User Management > Directory Stores > Add Directory > (Okta / Entra ID / JumpCloud / Create Custom Store) > API INTEGRATION: Sync endpoint and SCIM token
auth.notes: Okta sends the token as an HTTP Header (Authorization). The Microsoft Entra gallery app "Zoho One" uses OAuth (Code Auth Grant) instead of a static token.

operations.notes: Okta can Push New Users and Push Profile Updates; user status changes are synced when Status Sync is enabled. Okta custom app integrations cannot Push Groups; JumpCloud syncs users through selected user groups. Update method (PUT vs PATCH) not documented.

deprovision.notes: Status changes in the IdP deactivate the Zoho Directory user when Status Sync is on. Deactivation releases a Zoho Directory licence; whether it frees the app seat is not documented. People help says users disabled or deleted in Zoho Directory lose access to Zoho People.

filtering.notes: From Microsoft's Zoho One provisioning tutorial (userName marked as supported for filtering).

custom.how: Directory Store field mapping: profile field, hard-coded value, expression, custom attribute or JSON path mapped onto Zoho Directory fields (custom fields)

attributes.notes: Core and group attribute lists come from Microsoft's Zoho One provisioning tutorial (gallery app); Zoho Directory's own guides only describe field mapping in the admin panel.

roles.how: Zoho Directory conditional assignment assigns apps (and app roles, e.g. Zoho Desk roles/departments, Zoho CRM admin) based on group membership or designation; not a SCIM roles attribute

limitations.text: Okta custom app integrations cannot Push Groups or Import Groups.
JumpCloud syncs only groups of users, not individual users.
Entra provisioning runs on a 40-minute cycle (or on-demand Provision).
Zoho Directory Free plan allows only up to 10 users; paid Directory licences are $2 (Standard) or $7 (Professional) per user. How users of paid Zoho apps count against this is not documented.

user_api.notes: Employees are records in the Employee form; there is no separate user-management API. The employee insertRecord route is documented for standalone Zoho People only.

endpoints.purpose: Add an employee (invite or direct add with verified domain)
Fetch employee records (search by column, e.g. email)

rate_limits.text: Max calls/day: 5,000 (Essential HR), 10,000 (Professional), 15,000 (Premium), 25,000 (Enterprise); extra 50,000 calls/day sold as an add-on

limitations.text: Employee insertRecord is for standalone Zoho People only, not Zoho One, People Plus or other bundles.

okta.notes: No product-specific OIN app with provisioning; Zoho's guide uses a custom Okta SAML app with SCIM provisioning pointed at Zoho Directory.

entra.notes: Gallery app is "Zoho One" (also a separate "Zoho" SSO app). Microsoft says to contact Zoho One support to enable provisioning. Zoho Directory also documents Entra ID SCIM provisioning via a Directory Store (sync endpoint + SCIM token).

jumpcloud.notes: Zoho's guide uses a JumpCloud Custom Application with Identity Management (SCIM base URL + token); no JumpCloud catalogue page was checked.

fallbacks.other_sync: Active Directory/LDAP sync via Zoho Directory (users and groups appear in Zoho People)
